notes.title: New Factions and Advanced System Now Live!
notes.notes:
This update introduces 5 brand new factions and 24 unique builds, adding even more strategic depth to the game.

We have also introduced a brand-new Advanced System, with default full difficulty unlocked, allowing you to freely choose the most fitting challenge for you.

Additionally, we've optimized certain values and made adjustments to the new player tutorial for a smoother experience.

notes.title: Now supporting Russian and German
notes.notes:
We noticed that among our active users there are many players who speak Russian and German, so we have specifically added support for these two languages!
If you would like us to support more languages in the future, please feel free to leave a comment.
